text: [warm] Leah's illustrative offer sits at one point five points, short of that two-point mark; at her point, starts from both halves of history still cost more, including her April nineteen seventy-seven worst. A real offer has its own two rates, its own head start and its own place on the line. It also has what this replay leaves out: the lender's real index, a rate cap, a grace period, fees, and the borrower's own budget. The line doesn't say which offer is better; it shows what each head start meant in each kind of history. [calm] History, not a forecast.
